stem: What belongs in a maintenance handoff after a verification stops at an authority boundary?
choices: Only the technician’s guess at root cause.
Only a note that maintenance was called.
Exact asset/location, observed condition, evidence, operator actions, boundary cue, current safe status and receiving role.
rationale: Exact asset/location, observed condition, evidence, operator actions, boundary cue, current safe status and receiving role. This preserves the evidence and role boundary required by the referenced verification framework.
